scope: Embedded general registered-root Python connection and generated stubs; no new numerical algorithm, rebuilt community wheel or full-amplitude acceptance.

execution.sequence: Formatting, strict Clippy, seven release targets and post-run source verification under set -e.

release_tests.command: cargo test --locked --release --features python_stubgen --test python_algebraic_transport --test python_prescribed_transport --test python_cut_interfaces --test algebraic_cache --test canonical_cache --test supplied_singular_endpoints --test physical_transport -- --test-threads=8

coverage: Two physical variables and a coupled dense matrix with epsilon-independent entries; analytic epsilon coefficients through epsilon squared on both root sheets.
Two registered roots and a quotient denominator, with retained original norm-domain rejection.
Positive/negative prescribed threshold paths, exact hits, wrong or missing root germs, cancellation and unchanged banks on rejection.
Binary restart and nearby-source selection preserving input uncertainty; ordinary and prescribed finite endpoints retain separate terminal records.
Empty root declarations preserve legacy rational identity; malformed native declarations fail through existing typed errors.
Generated dense-constructor/property stubs use native Expression types; existing canonical, prescribed and cut Python interfaces remain checked.
accuracy_scope: Analytic comparisons require 20 scaled decimal digits using 100-digit native test arithmetic. Supplied numerical evidence is capped at 60 digits; transport cannot promote that evidence to working precision.
reuse_audit: Independent read-only review found no blocker. Binding dispatches to existing AlgebraicKinematicSystem/RustFlow owners; one shared official Symbolica/FeynKit/RustRed graph, no local dependency patch.
limits: Native epsilon-regularity, root/radicand and conservative source-norm restrictions remain.
General epsilon-singular basis transforms and constrained registered-root endpoint sectors remain separate work.
No global forward-error certificate, end-to-end performance comparison or fresh gg-to-Hg boundary acceptance is implied.
Publication extension and scientific banks remain unchanged.
